theorem regular (C : Family g.core) (hg : g.IsSimple) (h : C.Makes) : WilsonRegularity (wilsonFamily C) := by
  refine ⟨?_,fun N p v x => C.continuousO N p v.1 v.2 x, fun N p v x => C.invariant h N p v.1 v.2 x, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨2*Pert.Asymptotics.b0 g.core, ?_, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    · have hc := YM.Gauge.casimir_pos (GaugeGroup.coreSimple hg)
      unfold Pert.Asymptotics.b0
      positivity
    · filter_upwards [Pert.Asymptotics.zeroUp_bound C h hε] with N hN
      exact fun p => hN N p le_rfl
  intro v
  exact ⟨(C.localSection v.1).stencil,fun N p x => C.localO N p v.1 v.2 x⟩

def PositionsUV (C : Family G) (e : Extraction.Sequence) :=
  ∀ (p n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token),
   ∃ f : Points n → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (NoHit C.S p n) ∧
     (∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t → Tendsto (fun j => Order.smears C (e j) p v t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo f))) ∧
     ∀ l : List (Reach n),
       let F N := squall (C.S.a N) l (lifted C N p v)
       let g := derive f (l.map Reach.where_)
       Cluster C e p n F g ∧
       Meets (NoHit C.S p n) (fun j => interpolated C.S (e j) (F (e j))) g ∧
       ∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t →
         Integrable (fun x : Points n => t x * g x) ∧
         Tendsto (fun j => sumOn F C.S p (e j) t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo g))
ends.conclusion: `PositionsUV` gives, for every volume `p`, token list `v` and difference list `l`, a limiting kernel `f` (and its derivative `g`) such that the smeared lattice correlations converge along the full sequence for every `suitable` separated test.

theorem wilsonLimit {s : Extraction.Sequence} (h : (Extraction.Order.mk .full s).Ordered C S) :
    (wilsonFamily C).Converges s (fun v => (hierarchy F Q).correlation none ((hierarchy F Q).project ∘ v)) := by
  intro n v t
  obtain ⟨hv,row,hr,hl⟩ := fromWilson C h n v t
  refine ⟨hv,row,hr,?_⟩
  convert hl using 2
  congr 1
  funext x
  change t x * S.useAt S x (S.classTokens ∘ v) = t x * S.read x v
  by_cases hx : x ∈ conf n
  · rw [S.at_project S F.room.kernel.laws.toSymmetric (fun _ => le_rfl) hx]
  · have hz : t x = 0 := notMem_support.mp (fun h => hx (t.tsupport_subset (subset_closure h)))
    simp [hz]
ends.conclusion: `wilsonLimit` identifies the lattice limit with `correlation none (project ∘ v)` using `S.at_project` on `conf n`, and separated tests vanish off `conf n`.

  have ha : AnalyticAt ℝ (bring H d B) 0 := AnalyticAt.pi fun i => hp.shot (B i)

  let L : GaugePanel G m ≃ₗ[ℝ] PanelL2 G m := transport
  let T := L.toLinearMap.comp D.toLinearMap
  have commute (u : G.El) (y : GaugePanel G m) : L (rotates u y) = rotateIso u (L y) := rfl
  have ht (u : G.El) (x : Snap G d) : T (Cast u x) = rotateIso u (T x) := by

  refine ⟨C.comp L.toLinearMap, fun x => hc x, ?_⟩
  intro u y

  rw [commute, he]

private lemma deriv_comm (H : Hol G) (B : Fin m → Slot) (hp : Peg H d)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (bring H d B) 0) (u : G.El) (x : Snap G d) :
    fderiv ℝ (bring H d B) 0 (Cast u x) = rotates u (fderiv ℝ (bring H d B) 0 x) := by
  let F := bring H d B
  let D := fderiv ℝ F 0
  let P : Snap G d →L[ℝ] Snap G d := castL u
  let Q : GaugePanel G m →L[ℝ] GaugePanel G m := rotatesL u
  have ha : HasFDerivAt F D (P 0) := by rw [map_zero]; exact hd.hasFDerivAt
  have ha' : HasFDerivAt (F ∘ P) (D.comp P) 0 := ha.comp 0 P.hasFDerivAt
  have hb : HasFDerivAt (Q ∘ F) (Q.comp D) 0 := Q.hasFDerivAt.comp 0 hd.hasFDerivAt
  have eqn : F ∘ P = Q ∘ F := funext fun a => funext fun i => hp.observes (B i) u a
  rw [eqn] at ha'
  change D.comp P x = Q.comp D x
  rw [ha'.unique hb]

private lemma hammered {X Y ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] [CompleteSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) (C : Y →L[ℝ] X) (h : AnalyticAt ℝ f 0) (hh : C.comp (fderiv ℝ f 0)=ContinuousLinearMap.id _ _) (hz : f 0=0) (p : ι → X → X) (q : ι → Y → Y)
    (hx : ∀ i,Tendsto (p i) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)) (hy : ∀ i,Tendsto (q i) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)) (HP : ∀ i x,f (p i x)=q i (f x)) (HQ : ∀ i x,C (q i x)=p i (C x)) : ∃ F : Y → X,
      AnalyticAt ℝ F 0 ∧ F 0=0 ∧ (∀ᶠ i in 𝓝 0,F (f i)=i) ∧ ∀ u,∀ᶠ i in 𝓝 0,F (q u i)=p u (F i) := by
  let g := C ∘ f
  have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ω g 0 := ((C.analyticAt _).comp h).contDiffAt
  have ha : HasFDerivAt g (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ X).toContinuousLinearMap 0 := by
    rw [show (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ X).toContinuousLinearMap= C.comp (fderiv ℝ f 0) from hh.symm]
    exact C.hasFDerivAt.comp 0 h.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  let t := hg.toOpenPartialHomeomorph _ ha (by simp)
  have hw : ContDiffAt ℝ ω t.symm (g 0) := hg.to_localInverse ha (show ω≠(0:WithTop ℕ∞) by simp)
  have hT : g 0=0:=by simp [g,hz]
  have hs : (0:X)∈t.source:=ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source ..
  have ht : t.symm (0:X)=0 := by nth_rw 1 [← hT]; exact t.left_inv hs
  rw [hT] at hw
  let F := t.symm ∘ C
  have hi : F 0=0 := by simp [F,ht]
  have hq := (show AnalyticAt ℝ (t.symm) (C 0) from by rw [map_zero]; exact hw.analyticAt) |>.comp (C.analyticAt _)
  refine ⟨F,hq,hi,?_,fun i => ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [t.open_source.mem_nhds hs] with i hh; exact t.left_inv hh
  have he : 0∈t.target:= hT ▸ t.map_source hs
  have hl : Tendsto F (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [hi] using (show ContinuousAt F 0 from hq.continuousAt).tendsto
  have hu := t.open_source.mem_nhds hs
  have hH := t.open_target.mem_nhds he
  have hw : Tendsto C (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [map_zero] using C.continuous.tendsto 0
  filter_upwards [(hl.comp (hy i)).eventually hu,((hx i).comp hl).eventually hu,hw.eventually hH,(hw.comp (hy i)).eventually hH] with x ht hs he hb
  apply t.injOn ht hs
  change t (t.symm (C (q i x))) = g (p i (F x))
  rw [t.right_inv (show C (q i x) ∈ t.target from hb), show g (p i (F x))=p i (t (t.symm (C x))) from by
    change C (f _)=p i (C (f (F x)))
    rw [HP,HQ], t.right_inv he]
  exact HQ _ _

lemma min_cov {h : n → G.El} (hs : A.Solves h) (x : n) (k : G.El) :
    ∑ y, ∑ l, A.term h x y l ≤ ∑ y, ∑ l, G.price (k * A.W x y l * (h y)⁻¹) := by
  classical
  let g := update h x k
  let t (p : n → G.El) i j := ∑ l, A.term p i j l
  let M := Finset.univ.erase x
  have hn : 0 < (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hm : 0 < (Fintype.card L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have eq (p : n → G.El) : A.cost p = (Fintype.card n:ℝ)⁻¹ * (Fintype.card n:ℝ)⁻¹ * (Fintype.card L:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ∑ j, t p i j := by
    simp only [cost,avg, smul_eq_mul,← Finset.mul_sum,t,mul_assoc]
  have eq' (p : n → G.El) : (∑ i, ∑ j, t p i j) = (∑ i ∈ M, ∑ j ∈ M, t p i j) + 2*(∑ i, t p x i) := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ i ∈ M, ∑ j, t p i j) + ∑ j, t p x j := by rw [Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ x)]
      _ = (∑ i ∈ M, ((∑ j ∈ M, t p i j)+t p i x)) + ∑ j, t p x j := by
        unfold M; simp
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        have he : (∑ i ∈ M, t p i x) = ∑ i, t p x i := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ x), show t p x x = 0 by simp [t, term,A.same], add_zero]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ A.opposite p _ _
        rw [he]; ring
  have he := hs g
  rw [eq,eq, mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by positivity), eq', eq'] at he
  have hh (i) (hi : i ∈ M) : g i = h i := update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi) ..
  have hd (i) (hi : i ∈ M) (j) (hj : j ∈ M) : t h i j = t g i j := by simp only [t, term, hh i hi, hh j hj]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ hd i hi j hj,
    add_le_add_iff_left,mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by positivity)] at he
  apply he.trans
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
  unfold term g
  by_cases h' : i = x
  · subst i
    simp only [update_self, A.same,mul_one,mul_inv_cancel, G.price_one]
    exact (G.price_range _).1
  simp [h']

lemma scheme (i : S.patch.Points) : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (fun v : In G f => hats S y t v i) 0 := by
  let a := hats S y t (G:=G)
  let F := uncurry (fun x u => plant S y (x,u)) (α:=In G f)
  have hk : ContDiffAt ℝ ω F (0,a 0) := by
    refine contDiffAt_pi.mpr fun v => ?_
    unfold F uncurry plant
    dsimp only
    split
    · exact ((contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat v _).comp ((0:In G f),a 0) contDiffAt_snd).sub contDiffAt_const
    apply ((contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat v _).comp ((0:In G f),a 0) contDiffAt_snd).sub
    have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (fun x => G.mat (G.focus x)) (cloud S y (0,a 0) v)  :=
      by rw [show cloud _ _ _ _=1 from cloud_zero S y t (h:=h) _]; exact G.focus_diff
    exact hh.comp (f:=fun p => cloud S y p v) ((0:In G f),a 0) (cloud_form S y v (a 0))
  have hx : ∀ᶠ x : In G f in 𝓝 0,F (x,a x)=0 := by
    filter_upwards [roots S y t (G:=G), eventually_all.mpr (stars S y t (h:=h))] with x hx hh
    funext i; change plant _ _ _ _=_; unfold plant; split
    next hi => rw [hi]; simp [a,hx]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hh i)
  refine (contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat i _).comp 0 (authored a F 0 hx (continuousAt_pi.mpr fun i => hat_cont S y t (h:=h) i) hk fun u H => ?_)
ends.conclusion: The frame choice `hats` is real analytic near 0: the self-consistency equation `plant` (a nearest-point fixed point of the averaged `cloud`) is analytic and the real-analytic implicit function lemma `authored` applies with a trivial-kernel derivative.

lemma link_bound (S : StepData c f) (h : S.patch.Branches S.kernel G)
    (H : Forest S.ratio) (k : S.Choices) (x : Dir G f)
    (hx : ∀ e ∈ H.trunks, collect G x e = 0)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (e : Bond f)
    (hcops : ∀ U : Config G f, Stores.SliceSet S H U → usable S U (S.ratio.parent e.1) k →
      Cops (S := S) U 1 (S.prediction U k) e C) :
    ‖collect G x e‖ ≤ C * (∑ z ∈ box (macroR S.patch), ∑ p : PlaqAxes,
      ‖dColor G f 1 x (wrap f z + S.ratio.embed (S.ratio.parent e.1), plaquette p)‖) +
      ‖bills S x (S.ratio.parent e.1, coord e.2)‖ := by
  let U := fun t : ℝ => represent (t • x)
  have hu : U 0 = 1 := by simp [U]
  let i := S.ratio.parent e.1
  let edge : Bond c := (i, e.2)
  let loc := fun z : Cover => wrap f z + S.ratio.embed i
  let X := box (macroR S.patch)
  have he := chord_limit (U := fun t => U t e) (by rw [hu]; rfl) (represent_deriv x e)
  have hp := chord_limit (U := fun t => S.prediction (U t) k edge)
    (by rw [hu]; exact Push.settled S h edge k) (Push.prices S h edge k x)
  have hs (z : Cover) (p : PlaqAxes) :
      Tendsto (fun t => ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (faceValue (U t) (loc z,p)))
        (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 ‖dColor G f 1 x (loc z, plaquette p)‖) := by
    apply chord_limit
    · unfold U faceValue; rw [zero_smul]; exact Push.stroll_zero _ _
    · rw [← fundamental]; exact Push.travell _ _ _
  have ht : Tendsto (fun t => ∑ z ∈ X, ∑ p : PlaqAxes,
      ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (faceValue (U t) (loc z,p))) (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ))
        (𝓝 (∑ z ∈ X, ∑ p : PlaqAxes, ‖dColor G f 1 x (loc z,plaquette p)‖)) := by
    apply tendsto_finsetSum; intro z _; exact tendsto_finsetSum _ fun p _ => hs z p
  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto he ((ht.const_mul C).add hp)
  filter_upwards [(usable_near S x k i).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with t ht'
  have htree : Stores.SliceSet S H (U t) := by
    intro u hub
    change G.lieExp (t • (collect G x u)) * (1:G.El) = _
    rw [hx u hub, smul_zero, G.mat_lieExp_zero, mul_one]
  have ha := hcops (U t) htree ht'
  have ha' : G.chord ((U t) e) ≤ C * port S i (U t) + G.chord (S.prediction (U t) k edge) := by
    unfold Cops at ha
    simp only [replica_one, wire, Pi.one_apply, inv_one, mul_one, one_mul, G.chord_inv] at ha
    split at ha
    · exact ha.trans (add_le_add_right (G.chord_nonneg _) _)
    · exact ha
  change ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord ((U t) e) ≤ C * (∑ z ∈ X, ∑ p : PlaqAxes,
    ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (faceValue (U t) (loc z,p))) + ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (S.prediction (U t) k edge)
  have hh := ha'.trans (add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (port_le S (U t) i) hC) _)
  apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (show 0 ≤ ‖t‖⁻¹ by positivity)).trans_eq
  simp only [mul_add, mul_left_comm ‖t‖⁻¹ C, Finset.mul_sum, X, loc]
ends.conclusion: `link_bound` bounds a free link `collect G x e` of a slice field by `C` times the curls `dColor` in `box (macroR S.patch)` at the parent plus the `bills` value, by linearizing the nonlinear shell estimate `Cops` along `t • x`.
